notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l001: Continuation of Bakai's quotation of Manas addressing Koshoi on734:4:25–39; first-person campaign and childlessness remain in quoted memory, not Semetey's present deeds.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l014: Primary Yudakhin бил I = elephant; selected for strength, not wise men or rulers. Seventy in preceding verse belongs to camels only.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l016: Retained literal chewing fat in the marriage-promise sequence; no invented wedding rite beyond the words given.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l017: Primary бутта- I weigh by poods, with close gold/wedding-gift example; source here explicitly red copper, not changed to the dictionary example's red gold.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l018: Primary жеңкетай/жеңкетайлык = bridegroom's gifts to bride's elder female relatives who assist the wedding; rendered the gift and recipients, not a generic dowry or bride-price.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l021: Primary мерсент/мерсет = парзант, child. Same noun on25/26and4:22. Childlessness belongs to Manas's earlier plea, before Semetey's conception through blessing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l023: Туяк literally hoof, conventional descendant/heir; repeated heir/child parallel retained on23–26.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l027: Primary sources differ on material: Yudakhin кандагай specifies mountain-goat hide; same-epic1960Semeteyglossary371 specifies багыш (elk/moose) hide and special heroic trousers/armor. Root individually inspected glossary371 and read both definitions. Kept secure shared hide-trouser sense without imposing either animal. This is a qualification, not source emendation; footnote star excluded as apparatus.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l034: Conceived through a blessing is the narrator's miraculous account; not converted into a biological claim or omitted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b003:l037: Primary каран I = караан; караан sense3 support/protection, exact сизди караан кылып келдим seeking your protection. Restored initially held verse as Bakai looking to Semetey for support in Manas's place.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l003: Russian and Chinese feast guests retain the source's ethnonyms; no modern political implication added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l009: River and spring phrase retained as the printed image preceding the cherished child, with its precise figurative attachment provisional; not silently deleted as meaningless filler.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l010: Өлгөндө көргөн conventionally evokes the hard-won child found at death's door; not an assertion that a dead person literally gave birth. Same formulation737:5:27.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l011: Accusatory spear and near-death pursuit language retained as Bakai's reproach; no added wound location or assertion that Semetey died.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l014: Primary ичмек = lining underneath saddlecloth; шириден hide. Kept the lining and material rather than inventing saddle hardware.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l016: Valor is sarcastic reproach in context, not narrator endorsement of attacking an orphan.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0735:b004:l021: Manas as Kardigach's own blood brother retained; чындаган intensification provisionally rendered very own, without adding a moral claim of steadfastness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l001: Primary кара бас- evil spirit oppressing/possessing, also idiom of misfortune; retained Kardigach's hostile supernatural idiom.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l002: Primary суук дуба = harmful curse/spell, not cold weather. Source invokes it without giving a ritual or instructions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l003: Primary умач idiom көзүм умачтай ачылды = eyes opened wide, completely awakened. Not literal flour soup in the eyes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l010: Кыямат Manas's world-to-come association in threatened sacrifice retained; no exact date or literal resurrection invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l018: Indented3:19 joins18 into one verse. Brain-scattering threat extends through20–21; repeated dogs and some raging ones retained, without making the threatened killing an accomplished act.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l030: Printed агаларың is second-person possessive within reported gossip; retained your elder brothers rather than silently replacing the suffix.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b003:l035: Devouring kin and later being devoured by gossip remain the source's figurative language.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l014: Жылгындуу punctuated alongside Keng-Kol and Talas, provisionally the place Jilgynduu, supported by716:3:18 Жылгындууну жайлаптыр. Tamarisk-covered is the transparent adjectival alternative; no new geographical identification claimed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l020: Splitting lungs/taking gall is the printed hostile characterization of the two elder kinsmen, despite subsequent refusal to treat them as Chinese enemies; no narrative contradiction silently corrected.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l022: Indented4:23 joins22 as one verse. Konurbai remains the Chinese enemy in Beijing, distinct from Abyke/Kobosh.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l026: Primary коо1 vegetation-covered hollow, with ridge/valley example. Repeated dark/red ridge questions retained as rhetorical parallelism.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l036: Primary эриш I warp of weaving; literal shared-warp image provisionally retained for kinship. No claim of an independently established idiom or biological relationship beyond тууган.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0736:b004:l038: Semetey's gendered low-hem address and subsequent exclusion of married sister from natal kin preserved as character speech, not endorsed as fact.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l003: Different threshold and denial of kinship are Semetey's harsh patrilocal argument; explicit contradiction with repeatedly calling her sister is preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l008: Атан is a gelded camel, distinguished from атасы father on10; young camel and child parallel retained. Ком pack saddle/padding, not mountain ridge.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l013: Нар hybrid camel per primary dictionary; source explicitly seven hundred red animals.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l015: Literal braiding horse's tail retained in campaign preparation, no additional ritual invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l020: Ak Doo and Kok Doo retained as names of adversaries; components mean White Giant and Blue/Gray Giant. Not automatically the same as other giant names in prior episodes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l027: Manas-paternity oath retained as conditional self-curse, not a new genealogy claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l028: Primary exact туубай туна чөгөйүн = cursed be hour of birth / better never born. Kept oath rather than falsely literal drowning instructions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l039: Death-bound oath rendered upon our lives; no invented mechanism or ceremony. Day/date-writing and reckoning days remain literal on40/5:1.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l006: Зайыптык wife/woman status in continuing patrilocal reprimand; retained as wife rather than invented treachery.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l009: Threat is conditional on sister appearing when Semetey goes to his kin, not an accomplished killing; subsequent handshake and tears remain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l016: Primary аякташ adjoining/touching at ends, verb touching with tips of feet; burial threat rendered feet together with Manas, without invented new grave location.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l018: Both mothers retained, without adding names within verse; biological/foster relations not flattened to one mother.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l023: Primary кожосан epic protective spirit/patron; living Bakai bears the spiritual-protector epithet here, not claimed to have died or become a ghost.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l030: Primary күпү sense2 soft battle garment impervious to arrows, distinct sense1 camel-calf fur coat. Provisionally battle coat in mounted martial context; no cotton material or visible armor plates invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l033: Primary кабак sense2 hollow/depression and коо hollow support terrain reading beside deep; not silently turning this into a scowl or naming a place. Exact verbal кабактап nuance provisional.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b005:l039: Арам санайт here follows fear of what six scoundrels will do to the orphan; provisionally suspecting evil, not narrator saying Kardigach plans to harm him.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0737:b003:l021: Кыргынды кызык retains slaughter as sport in the threat; no narrator endorsement.
